name: 25560 · Scott Depot, WV
findings: ZIP 25560 (Scott Depot) has 23 nonprofit organizations. 5 of them (22%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 4 organizations.
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 25560 (Scott Depot) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
60% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.
